reviews.comment: I worked my butt off in this class, went to all TA sessions & every exam review: still got a D- may not be her fault but I wish there were extra credit opps or a way for my work to pay off even when math is hard for me. I appreciated her candor in class; her methods were not conducive to my mastery of the material. tanked my GPA for law school.

Overall, I really liked Prof. Whitfield, she is super nice, her exams are fairly easy if you study, and she cares alot about her students. The only thing I didn't like was she had pop quizzes (major assign) in class that you worked with a group to complete. We only had 10-20 min to complete them and it was very loud so it was hard for me to focus.
reviews.ratingTags: Inspirational--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I had Jenn for Math 140 and again for Math 142, and she made me WANT to come to class, even though math is hard for me. I'm actually gonna miss taking classes from her next semester! She is very helpful, fun, caring, brilliant, and SO GENUINE!!! She takes the time to learn everyone's names in class, and actively supports students at all levels! :D

Jen is a fantastic professor. I had never taken calculus before, so I was a little nervous, but due to Jens great teaching style, I was able to succeed in her class. She is very caring for her students, taking time to memorize their names, and is more than happy to explain problems as many times as it takes for a student to grasp the content.

I took Jenn for math 140 and loved her. I cannot say the same for 142. Lectures were often rushed and I was not able to fully understand key concepts. She could not explain concepts well and I felt lost. The 3 exams before the final are extremely hard and nothing like the homework problems. Jenn is such a nice person but not a good math 142 prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Jenn is so sweet and even though I struggled in her class, she made it easy to want to go to class. There is multiple homework assignments each week but her and her TA have alot of office hours.

Jenn is the sweetest professor ever. She really wants to ensure that you learn everything in this course. There is a lot of homework, as well as quizzes you take after reading the notes. In my opinion the tests are easier than the WebAssign homework. Make sure to study, or else you will not do well in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Jenn was friendly and willing to help. She tries to remember your name and get to know you. If you reach out, she will open up a homework assignment if you missed it as long as you don't overdo it. She drops about 2 homework at the end, 1 quiz, and 1 clicker. Her exams are "fair" but study days in advance and go to her office hours or the TA's.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: My favorite professor ever. I took her for MATH 140 and 142. Prof Patrick Orchard is same class but easier. Her exams are harder than his, so I would take him over her just because the exams are easier.

She is such a great person! Will take the time out of her week to help you if you ask and is always open to answering questions. As long as you keep up with the homework and go to class you should do just fine.

I love Professor Whitfield. Super helpful every single time I had a question. Always worked to help us even outside of hours. Went throughly over notes in class, the only reason I got a B was due to myself not preparing for the final. She's great.

Jen was one of the best professors I have ever had. She truly cares about all her students and wants them to succeed if they are putting in the work. She was very accessible outside of class and even after hours. Test 1, 2, and 3 were easy A's while the final was much tougher.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Whitfield is honestly the best. Extremely caring and inspiring, really cares about her students. If you go to her office hours or even before class, she will sit down with you individually and really explain your questions. Take her she's awesome!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, open to help her students at office hours. You can ask questions in class and shell do the best to answer it. Will check attendance using iClicker. Pretty easy class, just put some work into it and youll get good grades.

If you have the chance to get Jenn as your teacher, DO IT!!! I had so many friends in other class who were struggling because of their professor but Jenn is SO caring and truly wants you to succeed! She would literally sit down and work a problem a thousand times over with you until you understand it if she had to. Shes literally the best!!
Jenn was literally amazing. She does practice problems during lectures, and does a great job explaining the material.

Would 100000% recommend taking Professor Whitfield for Math 140. Explains concepts in ways that you can understand. She is very kind and will help you understand concepts if you didn't grasp them in class. Had friends in other Math 140 courses who went through an unnecessarily difficult experience. One of the best professors here!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: *MATH 171 REV * Jenn is probably one of the most relatable persons I've ever met. She's willing to answer any question before or after lecture, and she breaks down the material. Comparing her exams to that of Math 151 exams from the TAMU Math department, they're a breeze. Weekly HW's that she'll push back if we didn't finish the material in class.

Jenn really cared for her class. She would remove concepts from the exams if we didn't cover the concepts before test day. Homework was not difficult, and she returned graded assignments quickly. Her lectures were enjoyable and informative, if you paid attention. She also offered multiple extra office hour sessions before exams.

I LOVE Jenn, she is the sweetest woman ever. She's always open to giving extensions on homework, and listened to her students more than ANY professor I've had. Office hours and/or prior calc knowledge is a must. Exams are hard, I began studying a week before and got 70-80. Great teacher, hard exams. If you put in the work you will pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: By far the best professor I have had. She offers exam corrections that allow you to get half the points you missed back and offers so much help. She also drops your lowest test grade if your final is higher than it so your final doesn't hurt your final grade. I recommend her wholeheartedly.

I took MATH140 last semester & most of it I already knew how to do because I took it in high school. I would get answers right, but she would count them wrong because I didnt solve it the way she wanted me to. She would make us go through 3 diff. websites just to turn in a quiz. My experience with her was not great & I wouldnt take her again.
Toughest grader I've ever had. Even if the answer is correct, she'd still dock an obscene amount of points off of tests.

Jenn was an good person, but not the best prof. She made a point to always be available, but since we learned so little during the actual lecture she would just do our work for us. The tests always had curveballs. Kids would score in the 10's on exams. I used all the resources available & paid for additional tutoring but still struggled to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Math 142 has been the hardest math class I have ever taken, but Professor Whitfield helped as much as she could and she was constantly making herself available to provide us with extra help. Going to her office hours also helps a lot. This class is not easy, but if you put in the time and effort, you will pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Jenn is a great professor! Math is not my favorite subject but Jenn made it enjoyable and easier to understand. She truly cares about all her students and cares whether or not you understand the material. Would 100% take her again!

Dr. Whitfield was a very caring and sweet woman however, she wasn't the best a teaching math. She goes so fast that I would get lost and not understand, she would also skip steps. I sometimes felt like it was a waste attending class because I would leave understanding nothing. I spent hours at TutorHub for help with the homework and still got a D.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Jenn is the most incredible math professor I have ever had. She goes so far out of her way to ensure students have as many resources as possible to do well in the class. Calculus is a hard class, but Jenn provides excellent feedback and study tips. As long as you study, the class is doable. Attend tutor sessions as well.

Jenn is a real gem of a math professor. If math isn't you're strong suit, she is plenty available outside of class and willing to work with you to make sure you understand the material. If you apply yourself, pay attention in class, go to office hours, etc. you'll do great. I'm in her 142 class now and she's still as caring as last semester.

Professor Whitfield is the best prof I've had so far at tamu. She really cares about whether or not her students understand the material and takes time to explain it to those who don't. I've taken two of her classes and it is evident she is passionate about her course and wants you to succeed.

Prof Jenn is one of the most caring and hard working professors I have had in my 4 years of college. She cares about EVERY student, her heart and soul is in it, making a space of positive learning. Her encouraging/nurturing attitude is accompanied by her passion to teach. Even if math is not your strength, she will get you through it and w/ a smile

Mrs. Whitfield was an awesome professor. She's great at explaining difficult concepts and will take extra time to make sure you understand what she's teaching. You can tell she really cares about her students.

Prof. Whitfield is a solid professor. The people that say she doesnt teach are just not paying attention in lecture and not going to help sessions. She walks through examples and calls on people. She gives you the option to participate with her as she walks through problems. She walks through multiple problems. And she doesnt play favorites
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She's overrated. She's just okay. She develops an inner circle and only cares about those students.
Prof Jenn was so amazing. She was really dedicated to making sure everyone understood what was going on. Hw was only once or twice a week. It was pretty easy overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: I took her online MATH140 class, which was an easy A, but was also the most frustrating class and professor Ive ever had to deal with. She would change the times that assignments were due, would assign a ridiculous amount of homework, and would assign work that wasnt for a grade, but was mandatory. Youll get an A but in the most frustrating way.
She was an excellent teacher!
makes the class fun and she genuinely cares about her students
Jenn is a very nice and understanding professor. She cares about her students and is very approachable. She will go a long way to clearly answer any questions you have.

Jenn's the best! Wish she was teaching Math 152 next semester! She's really good at explaining things and will work out problems in class based on what the students have questions on or are struggling with. She also will make extra office hours when needed and helps out the students whenever she can. Would definitely recommend!

I've taken calc before but she explained things very clearly and gives you everything you need to do the homework and for the tests. She is willing to move due dates depending on other classes and student feedback also. Her office hours are helpful to and she is concerned about helping students who haven't taken calc before!

No need to buy the textbook because it's available online. Immediately you know she is a pretty chill teacher when she asks you to call her Jen. She's really there for students and tries to make sure that her students have seen every type of problem on the exam.

Jenn was amazing. She's super fun in lectures and does all she can to help you. She explains the material at an elementary level, I had previously taken calculus but she explained things in a way that made things easier to understand. She pretty much gives you all you need to know for homework and tests, she also does in class test reviews.

She's the best professor ever. She seriously cares about her students, she wants to see you grasp the material. She is a harsh grader on tests (workout portion), but she will well prepare you for the test. Take her! She explains every step thoroughly. I wish she taught Math 152!
She is highly interested in her students, if you ask for help she would most definitely try her best to make you understand. Doing the suggested homework you will be fine. Funny and laid back.
Very helpful. Funny, keeps your attention, gets to know the students. Laid back.
Great Math 151 professor. Apparent that she actually cares if her students learn. Very approachable and has a good personality to go along with her knowledge of the subject.
No Comments
If  you pay attention and do the suggested homework, you should do fine. She is a fun prof and gets to know the students. Very approachable and answers questions.
